caseName: Portsmouth Harbor Land & Hotel Co v. United States
caseNameFull: THE PORTSMOUTH HARBOR LAND AND HOTEL COMPANY CAROLINE E. PEABODY AMORY ELIOT, ADMINISTRATOR S. ELLERY JENNISON AND MARY M. JENNISON v. United States
syllabus:
Additional discharges of projectiles over part of plaintiffs’ land, held, not to involve a taking of property. Peabody v. United States, 231 U. S., 530.

Applications for remand and for additional findings denied.
summary: Judgment was rendered in favor of the defendants in the court below. On appeal the judgment was affirmed, and the Supreme Court decided:

opinions.author: White
opinions.text:
Mr. Chief Justice White

delivered a memorandum opinion of the Supreme Court May 19, 1919.
